label: Synthetic demonstration data, not actual participants or demand research

ideas.title: 一張葉子的藍：藍曬明信片
ideas.title_en: A leaf in blue: cyanotype postcards
ideas.goal: 每人帶一片落葉；小組比較遮片、曝光與圖案，帶走一張紙本作品。
ideas.goal_en: Bring a fallen leaf, compare masks and exposure, and leave with a postcard.
ideas.format: A small group creates a concrete result, compares observations, and keeps source-linked personal notes.

ideas.title: 把街角紋理，拓進一本小冊
ideas.goal: 兩人一組找紋理、做紙上拓印，再交換各自讀到的街道故事。
ideas.goal_en: Work in pairs to collect textures, make rubbings and exchange street stories.
ideas.format: A small group creates a concrete result, compares observations, and keeps source-linked personal notes.

ideas.title: 陽台小菜園：一起配一盆土
ideas.title_en: A balcony garden: mix your first pot
ideas.goal: 對照採光與澆水記錄，四人共同配土，約定一週後交流觀察。
ideas.goal_en: Compare light and watering notes, mix soil in a group of four and review after a week.
ideas.format: A small group creates a concrete result, compares observations, and keeps source-linked personal notes.

ideas.title: 把一個生活故事，說成三分鐘英語
ideas.title_en: Tell a daily story in three minutes
ideas.goal: 用買菜、問路與介紹興趣的情境練習，輪流當說話者與回饋者。
ideas.goal_en: Practise shopping, directions and introductions; alternate speaking and feedback.
ideas.format: A small group creates a concrete result, compares observations, and keeps source-linked personal notes.

ideas.title: 一條街的記憶：學會問一個好問題
ideas.title_en: Street memories: ask a better question
ideas.goal: 先練習開放式提問，再用自願分享的故事製作有授權的文字摘錄。
ideas.goal_en: Practise open questions and create consented excerpts from volunteered stories.
ideas.format: A small group creates a concrete result, compares observations, and keeps source-linked personal notes.

ideas.title: 把活動資訊，整理成一張讀得懂的海報
ideas.title_en: Make an event poster people can understand
ideas.goal: 把時間、地點、準備清單與報名方式重新編排，交換可讀性回饋。
ideas.goal_en: Arrange time, location, preparation and registration details; exchange readability feedback.
ideas.format: A small group creates a concrete result, compares observations, and keeps source-linked personal notes.

ideas.title: 一起修好一件捨不得丟的衣服
ideas.title_en: Repair a piece of clothing you love
ideas.goal: 從鈕扣與簡單破口開始，輪流示範並記下適合不同布料的方法。
ideas.goal_en: Start with buttons and small tears; share methods for different fabrics.
ideas.format: A small group creates a concrete result, compares observations, and keeps source-linked personal notes.

ideas.title: 同一款茶，為什麼喝起來不同？
ideas.title_en: One tea, different cups: compare your method
ideas.goal: 小組分工記錄時間、水量與感官描述，不給口味好壞排名。
ideas.goal_en: Record time, water and tasting notes together, without ranking personal tastes.
ideas.format: A small group creates a concrete result, compares observations, and keeps source-linked personal notes.

ideas.title: 聽見日常：製作一張聲音明信片
ideas.title_en: Listen to everyday life: a sound postcard
ideas.goal: 採集三段不含可辨識談話的環境聲，互相命名、整理成一分鐘作品。
ideas.goal_en: Collect three ambient sounds without identifiable speech and edit a one-minute piece.
ideas.format: A small group creates a concrete result, compares observations, and keeps source-linked personal notes.

ideas.title: 畫一張能讓新朋友用上的社區地圖
ideas.title_en: Map a neighbourhood for a newcomer
ideas.goal: 整理飲水、休息、交通與無障礙資源，注明來源和待核對的路線。
ideas.goal_en: Map water, rest, transport and accessibility resources with sources and open questions.
ideas.format: A small group creates a concrete result, compares observations, and keeps source-linked personal notes.
